name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add ComfyUI’s SD3.5 Medium RealVisXL LoRA to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It’s the fastest way to boost image quality without slowing the pipeline—RealVisXL’s photorealism adds detail where users care most. Trade-off: it burns GPU memory, so we’ll cap batch size to keep latency flat.

name: Torque
text: RealVisXL’s realism won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler. Better: test SD3.5 Medium with InstantX *before* adding LoRAs; if faces still degrade, switch to SDXL Turbo + a face-focused upscaler like SwinIR. Settle it with a side-by-side A/B test on 100 faces—no GPU memory cap, just raw quality delta.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It directly attacks the face fidelity drop Torque flagged by sharpening edges where depth changes—faces included—without adding new models. Trade-off: depth-aware upscaling slows the pipeline slightly, so we’ll run it at half-resolution for faces and upscale only those regions to keep latency under control.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because it sharpens edges, not faces—faces are flat regions where depth cues fail. Test SDXL Turbo with SwinIR’s face-focused upscaling first; if faces still blur, the real risk is wasted GPU cycles on a tool that doesn’t solve the core problem. Settle it with a side-by-side A/B test on 100 faces, measuring face sharpness and pipeline latency.
